g.text: Transient Theis superposition, homogeneous infinite confined aquifer, T=200 m²/day and storage coefficient0.001. Drawdown axis increases downward. Well
radius0.2 m clips the point singularity. Specific capacity Q/s depends on time, neighboring pumping, and well losses; it is not transmissivity. No
